AdminUser.resetPinConfirm:
{name}: issue a temporary password?

Only if the user asked for it after forgetting their password. The old password stops working, and at the next login the user will be asked to set a new one.

actions.approvalHint: Check that the license and experience match the role. Once approved, the professional appears in searches.
actions.deletedHint: Cannot log in and is not visible anywhere on the platform. Nothing has been erased.
actions.suspendHint: Temporary freeze: the user cannot log in and does not appear in searches until you reactivate the account.
actions.deleteHint: The account is hidden from the platform and cannot log in. Nothing is erased (history, reviews, balance) and you can restore it from here at any time. Open requests are cancelled; any credits charged are refunded.
actions.staffHint: Can also access this console with the same phone number and password. Only for a trusted person.
